RESERVE BANK OF INDIA - REGULATORY
 CIRCULAR
RBI/2024-25/112 | DOR.CRE.REC.No.66/21.04.048/2024-25
Subject: Guidelines on Default Loss Guarantee (DLG) in Digital
Lending Transactions
1. Regulated Entities (REs) entering into DLG arrangements with Lending Service Providers (LSPs)
shall ensure that total DLG cover on any outstanding portfolio shall not exceed 5.0% of that loan
portfolio amount.
2. Forms of DLG: DLG shall be accepted only in the following forms: (a) Cash deposited with the RE,
(b) Fixed Deposits maintained with a Scheduled Commercial Bank with a lien marked in favor of the
RE, or (c) Bank Guarantee in favor of the RE.
3. Tenor of DLG: The period of DLG agreement shall not be less than the longest tenor of the
underlying loans in the portfolio.
4. Disclosure: REs shall publish on their website the total number of portfolio-level DLG arrangements,
the names of LSPs, and the total quantum of DLG invoked during the financial year.

Material Related Party Transactions Thresholds:
A transaction with a related party shall be considered material if the transaction(s) to be entered into
individually or taken together with previous transactions during a financial year, exceeds rupees one
thousand crore (INR 1,000 Cr) or 10% of the annual consolidated turnover of the listed entity as per the
last audited financial statements, whichever is lower.

TATA MOTORS PASSENGER ELECTRIC MOBILITY
 LIMITED - STATUTORY AUDIT NOTES
Note 18: Capital Expenditure & Battery Cell Sourcing Commitments
The Company has entered into long-term irrevocable supply agreements for lithium iron phosphate
(LFP) and nickel manganese cobalt (NMC) battery cells with Agratas Energy Storage Solutions. Total
capital commitment under Phase 1 stands at INR 13,000 Crores across Gujarat and Sanand facilities.
Liquidated damages for supply default are capped at 7.5% of annual purchase value.
Note 19: Government Subsidies & FAME-II Ineligibility Contingency
Receivables under FAME-II subsidy claim stood at INR 784.50 Crores as of March 31, 2024. Ministry of
Heavy Industries initiated an audit regarding phased manufacturing program (PMP) localization norms.
Management considers the entire sum recoverable and has not made any impairment provision.

RESERVE BANK OF INDIA MASTER DIRECTION - NBFC PRUDENTIAL NORMS (SCALE BASED REGULATION)
Circular Ref: RBI/DNBR/2023-24/89
Applicable to: NBFC-Base Layer (BL), NBFC-Middle Layer (ML), NBFC-Upper Layer (UL).

Section 12: Tier 1 and Tier 2 Capital Requirements
1. Minimum Capital Ratio: Every NBFC-ML and NBFC-UL shall maintain a minimum Capital to Risk-weighted Assets Ratio (CRAR) of 15% on an ongoing basis.
2. Tier 1 Capital shall not be less than 10.0% of risk-weighted assets.
3. Subordinated Debt eligible for Tier 2 capital shall be subject to progressive discounting at 20% per annum during the last 5 years to maturity.

Section 18: Non-Performing Asset (NPA) Classification Timeline
- An asset shall be classified as NPA if interest or installment of principal remains overdue for more than 90 days.
- Upgradation of accounts classified as NPA: Upgradation can happen ONLY after all arrears of interest and principal are paid by the borrower in full.

RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LIMITED - O2C (OIL TO CHEMICALS) & PETROCHEMICAL CAPEX DISCLOSURE
Audited Notes to Consolidated Accounts - Schedule IX

1. Jamnagar Refinery Upgradation Project:
Total Sanctioned Capex: USD 9.5 Billion (INR 79,200 Cr).
Incurred till Q4 FY24: USD 6.2 Billion.
Expected Commercial Operation Date (COD): Q3 FY26.
Debt vs Equity Financing Ratio: 65:35.

2. Carbon Fiber & Polymer Specialization Plant:
Contractor: McDermott & Larsen & Toubro Consortium.
Warranty Period: 36 months post commissioning.
Contingent Liabilities: Outstanding performance guarantees amounting to INR 2,450 Crores submitted to Gujarat Maritime Board.

SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA (SEBI)
Master Circular for ESG Rating Providers (ERPs) | SEBI/HO/DDHS/DDHS-POD-2/P/CIR/2024/45

1. Mandatory Rating Products:
(a) Core ESG Rating: Based entirely on audited and verified BRSR (Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting) Core metrics.
(b) Comprehensive ESG Rating: Integrating global supply chain disclosures and unverified disclosures.

2. Conflict of Interest & Fee Structure:
- ERPs shall not provide consulting or advisory services to entities they rate within a lookback period of 24 months.
- Subscriber-pays model vs Issuer-pays model: If Issuer-pays model is used, ERP must disclose historical rating distribution annually on website.

ICICI BANK LIMITED - TREASURY OPERATIONS & INTEREST RATE RISK DISCLOSURE
Base Rate vs Repo-Linked Lending Rate (RLLR) Portfolio Sensitivity

1. Sensitivity to +/- 100 bps Interest Rate Shift:
- Impact on Net Interest Income (NII) over 12-month horizon: INR 1,840 Crores (+/- 3.2%).
- Modified Duration of Available for Sale (AFS) Fixed Income Portfolio: 2.14 years.
- Modified Duration of Held to Maturity (HTM) G-Sec Portfolio: 4.82 years.

2. Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR):
Weighted Average LCR for Q4 FY24 stood at 122.4% (Regulatory requirement: 100.0%).
High-Quality Liquid Assets (HQLA) Pool: INR 312,450 Crores, predominantly Level 1 Sovereign Assets.

KOTAK MAHINDRA BANK - INDEPENDENT AUDITOR EMPHASIS OF MATTER
Audit Firm: Walker Chandiok & Co LLP & Price Waterhouse LLP Joint Audit

Emphasis of Matter: Technical Outages and RBI Regulatory Supervisory Restrictions
On April 24, 2024, the Reserve Bank of India directed the Bank to:
1. Cease onboarding new customers through online and mobile banking channels.
2. Halt issuance of fresh credit cards.

Financial Impact Assessment:
- Credit card portfolio contributed 8.2% of total retail fee income in FY24.
- Management estimated customer acquisition remediation capex at INR 450 Crores over FY25 to upgrade Core Banking Infrastructure (CBS) and disaster recovery switchover time from 45 minutes to under 5 minutes.

BAJAJ FINANCE LIMITED - ASSET LIABILITY MANAGEMENT (ALM) & CONCENTRATION RISK REPORT
Classification as NBFC-UL (Upper Layer)

Concentration of Top 20 Borrowers:
- Aggregate exposure to top 20 advances: INR 14,890 Crores (4.8% of total loan book).
- Largest single borrower exposure: INR 1,850 Crores (Commercial Real Estate - Residential construction).
- Capital to Risk Assets Ratio (CRAR): 22.52% (Tier 1: 21.51%, Tier 2: 1.01%).
- Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Stage 3 Coverage: 64.2% on secured assets, 84.8% on two-wheeler/unsecured micro-loans.

FOREIGN EXCHANGE MANAGEMENT ACT (FEMA) - RBI MASTER DIRECTION ON OVERSEAS DIRECT INVESTMENT (ODI)
Notification No. FEMA 400/2022-RB (Updated March 2024)

Rule 9: Limit on Financial Commitment by Indian Entity
1. Total financial commitment made by an Indian entity in all foreign entities shall not exceed 400% of its net worth as per the last audited balance sheet.
2. Net Worth Calculation: Paid-up equity capital + Free reserves + Securities premium - Accumulated losses - Deferred expenditure.
3. Permissible Modes: Equity, Debt instruments, Loan, Guarantee (Corporate, Personal, Bank), Pledge of shares/assets.

ZOMATO LIMITED - QUICK COMMERCE (BLINKIT) UNIT ECONOMICS & METRICS
Quarter Ended March 31, 2024

Key Operational Metrics:
- Gross Order Value (GOV): INR 4,027 Crores (Q4 FY24) vs INR 1,675 Crores (Q4 FY23).
- Average Order Value (AOV): INR 617 vs INR 522 in Q4 FY23.
- Dark Store Count: 526 active stores across 26 cities.
- Average GOV per day per store: INR 8.4 Lakhs.
- Contribution Margin (% of GOV): +3.9% in Q4 FY24 vs -2.6% in Q4 FY23.
- Take Rate (Net Revenue as % of GOV): 19.4%.

LARSEN & TOUBRO LIMITED - ORDER INFLOW & BACKLOG SUMMARY FY24
Audited Segmental Order Inflow Report

1. Total Consolidated Order Inflow: INR 3,02,812 Crores (+31% YoY).
2. International Orders Share: 47% (Major orders from Saudi Aramco, ADNOC, and QatarEnergy).
3. Hydrocarbon & Green Energy Segment: Order backlog stands at INR 1,14,500 Crores.
4. Retention Monies & Working Capital Cycle:
- Net Working Capital as % of revenue: 12.2% (FY24) vs 16.1% (FY23).
- Customer advances outstanding: INR 28,450 Crores.

AXIS BANK LIMITED - FORM SE-16: DISCLOSURE OF CYBERSECURITY READINESS & TESTING
Reg: SEBI Circular on Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience framework

1. Third-Party Vendor Security Audits:
- Total vendor integrations reviewed in FY24: 342 critical APIs.
- Critical vulnerabilities identified and remediated within SLA (15 days): 100%.
- Mean Time to Detect (MTTD): 4.2 minutes.
- Mean Time to Respond (MTTR): 14.8 minutes.

2. Incident Reporting:
Zero material breaches or unauthorized exfiltration of customer PII occurred during FY24.

SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA (ALTERNATIVE INVESTMENT FUNDS) REGULATIONS
SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD/CIR/2024/16

Regulation 15: Investment Conditions for Category II and Category III AIFs
1. Category II AIF shall invest not more than 25% of its investable funds in an unlisted investee company directly or through investment in units of other AIFs.
2. Category III AIF shall invest not more than 10% of its investable funds in an investee company.
3. Un-invested portion of investable funds may be held in liquid funds, Treasury Bills, or repo in government securities.

SUN PHARMACEUTICAL INDUSTRIES LIMITED - REGULATORY UPDATE ON US FDA INSPECTION
Facility: Halol Manufacturing Plant & Mohali Oral Solid Dosage Facility

1. Mohali Facility Status:
- US FDA completed inspection between June 10-18, 2024.
- Issued Form FDA 483 with 5 procedural observations.
- Observations relate to environmental monitoring in aseptic packaging lines and batch record documentation.
- Facility currently under Import Alert 66-40 with exemptions for 14 life-saving oncology formulations.

2. Financial Provisioning:
Revenue contribution from Mohali facility to US sales: ~3.5% (approx USD 65 Million). No asset impairment charged to P&L.

WIPRO LIMITED - HUMAN RESOURCES, ATTRITION & UTILIZATION METRICS FY24
Audited Supplementary Disclosures

1. Employee Headcount & Attrition:
- Total Headcount as of March 31, 2024: 234,054 employees.
- Net Reduction in FY24: 24,516 employees.
- Voluntary Attrition (Trailing Twelve Months - TTM): 14.2% (vs 21.9% in FY23).
- Gross Utilization (excluding trainees): 84.8% (Q4 FY24) vs 79.8% (Q1 FY24).

2. Offshore vs Onsite Delivery Ratio:
- Offshore Effort Mix: 58.4%
- Onsite Effort Mix: 41.6%
- Subcontractor expenses as % of revenue: 9.8%.

ONE 97 COMMUNICATIONS LIMITED (PAYTM) - BUSINESS RESTRUCTURING UPDATE
Response to RBI Directive on Paytm Payments Bank Limited (PPBL) dated January 31, 2024

1. Transition of UPI Handle & Merchant Acquiring:
- Migration of `@paytm` handles to 4 PSP Banks: Axis Bank, HDFC Bank, State Bank of India, and YES Bank.
- Nodal Account migration completed to Axis Bank escrow account.

2. Financial Impact on GMV (Gross Merchandise Value):
- Monthly GMV dipped from INR 1.65 Lakh Crores (Jan 2024) to INR 1.12 Lakh Crores (March 2024).
- Soundbox and POS device subscription net additions paused in Feb-March 2024; active device count stood at 10.7 Million as of Q4 FY24.

STATE BANK OF INDIA - ACTUARIAL VALUATION OF RETIREMENT BENEFIT OBLIGATIONS
Note 34 to Standalone Financial Statements FY24

1. Pension & Gratuity Liabilities:
- Present Value of Defined Benefit Obligation: INR 84,210 Crores.
- Fair Value of Plan Assets: INR 79,450 Crores.
- Net Deficit recognized in Balance Sheet: INR 4,760 Crores.
- Discount Rate applied: 7.15% per annum (based on 10-year G-Sec yield).
- Expected Rate of Salary Escalation: 6.00% per annum.

ADANI PORTS AND SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE LIMITED (APSEZ)
DEBT MATURITY PROFILE & BOND REFINANCING DISCLOSURE

1. Total Outstanding Gross Debt: INR 45,820 Crores (as of March 31, 2024).
- Net Debt to EBITDA ratio: 2.3x (vs covenant ceiling of 3.5x).
- Cash and Cash Equivalents: INR 8,940 Crores.

2. Upcoming Bond Maturities:
- July 2024 US$ Dollar Bonds: USD 650 Million (Refinancing completed via internal accruals & syndicated loan).
- 2027 Notes: USD 750 Million at coupon of 4.00%.
- Average Cost of Borrowing: 7.2% per annum across all tranches.

NTPC GREEN ENERGY LIMITED - DRAFT RED HERRING PROSPECTUS (DRHP) SUMMARY
Objects of the Initial Public Offering (IPO)

1. Issue Size: Fresh Issue of Equity Shares aggregating up to INR 10,000 Crores.
2. Utilization of Net Proceeds:
- Repayment/Prepayment of certain outstanding borrowings of subsidiary (NTPC Renewable Energy Ltd): INR 7,500 Crores.
- General Corporate Purposes: INR 2,500 Crores.

3. Operational Capacity:
- Operational Renewable Capacity: 3,071 MW (Solar: 2,950 MW, Wind: 121 MW).
- Pipeline / Contracted Capacity under construction: 11,200 MW.
- Power Purchase Agreements (PPA) Weighted Average Tariff: INR 2.68 per kWh with average PPA duration of 25 years.

ITC LIMITED - SCHEME OF ARRANGEMENT FOR DEMERGER OF HOTEL BUSINESS
National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Kolkata Filing

1. Share Entitlement Ratio:
For every 10 (Ten) Ordinary Shares of face value of Re. 1/- each held in ITC Limited, 1 (One) Equity Share of face value of Re. 1/- each in ITC Hotels Limited shall be issued.

2. Post-Demerger Shareholding Pattern of ITC Hotels Limited:
- Directly held by existing shareholders of ITC Limited: 60%.
- Held by ITC Limited (Parent entity): 40%.

BHARTI AIRTEL LIMITED - IMPACT OF NIGERIAN NAIRA DEVALUATION ON CONSOLIDATED RESULTS
Audited Financial Notes FY24 - Note 41

1. Foreign Exchange Devaluation:
The Central Bank of Nigeria unified exchange rate windows leading to a devaluation of the Nigerian Naira (NGN) against USD by over 100% during the year.

2. Impact on Profit Before Tax:
- Exceptional forex loss recognized: INR 5,420 Crores in consolidated P&L.
- Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) in Nigeria (in USD terms) dropped from $4.8 to $2.2, while constant currency local ARPU grew by 11.4%.

VEDANTA LIMITED - DISCLOSURE OF ENCUMBERED SHARES UNDER SEBI SAST REGULATIONS
Promoter Shareholding & Encumbrance Status as of March 31, 2024

1. Promoter Holding Details:
- Total Promoter Group Shareholding: 63.71% (236.6 Crore shares).
- Percentage of Promoter Shares Pledged/Encumbered: 99.8% of total promoter holding.
- Purpose of Encumbrance: Securing term loan facilities and bond obligations availed by parent entity Vedanta Resources Limited (VRL) UK.

2. Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR):
Consolidated DSCR stood at 1.42x. Total interest outflow for FY25 projected at INR 6,800 Crores.
